Name: Gruene Estate
Description: The original Gruene family farm: 17 acres near the Gruene Historic District with an open-air stained-glass chapel.

Name: The Chapel at Gruene
Description: Small-wedding venue on 10 acres a mile from Gruene, with an outdoor chapel, reception hall and four cottages sleeping 25.

Name: Hidden Gem of Gruene
Description: Twenty-one acres near the Guadalupe River with an oak-shaded ceremony site, climate-controlled hall and on-site lodging.

Name: Geronimo Oaks
Description: Family-run working ranch with two venues: The Creeks for up to 175 and West Texas for up to 300.

Name: Paniolo Ranch
Description: Ranch bed and breakfast with a stone altar overlooking a lake, an indoor reception hall and an on-site spa.

Name: Eagle Dancer Ranch
Description: Climate-controlled rustic venue on the Guadalupe River between Boerne and Sisterdale.

Name: Kendall Point
Description: Purpose-built wedding venue from 2011 with wrap-around porches and bridal and groom suites.

Name: The Gardens at Old Town Helotes
Description: Manor house and landscaped grounds northwest of San Antonio, with all-inclusive packages priced by guest count.

Name: La Escondida Celebration Center
Description: Creekside Hill Country property with a pavilion and pond patio, currently booking micro weddings.

Name: Lost Mission
Description: Sixty acres with a Spanish-style chapel, reception hall and in-house catering.

Name: The Orchard at Spring Branch
Description: Hill Country venue with a chapel, reception spaces and on-site suites.

Name: The Preserve at Canyon Lake
Description: A 15,000 sq ft venue on a wildlife preserve, with an indoor chapel, courtyard and ballroom.

Name: Weddings at Canyon Lakeview Resort
Description: Lakeside ceremony site and ballroom; bookings require a two-night stay in the resort's 16 lodge suites.

Name: The Gunter Hotel
Description: Downtown hotel with a chandelier ballroom and terrace, 311 rooms and 30 suites.

Name: The Menger Hotel
Description: Hotel on Alamo Plaza dating from 1859, with a grand ballroom and smaller historic rooms.

Name: Hotel Emma
Description: Hotel in the former Pearl brewhouse, with historic indoor rooms and outdoor spaces.

Name: Lambermont Events
Description: Restored 1894 castle-style mansion with a garden ceremony area and overnight rooms for 10.

Name: The Red Berry Estate
Description: Lakeside mansion ten minutes from downtown with a ballroom, veranda and gardens.

Name: San Antonio Botanical Garden
Description: Thirty-nine-acre botanical garden minutes from downtown that rents out event spaces.
